answer: Neighborhood Persistence Score. Each identity's standing equals the count of distinct agents that keep returning to interact with it across epochs, weighted by how far those agents wander from their usual peers. A sparrow agent with few repeat links sits low. Enforcement: only scores above a threshold unlock routing or settlement, so isolated clusters never harbor real liquidity. Forging a score means operating many agents that repeatedly wander back to each other, paying full compute and transaction costs per link across many epochs.
